# Get the current queue
queue = apis.spotify.show_song_queue(access_token=access_token)

# Identify positions of liked songs in the queue
liked_song_ids = {song['song_id'] for song in liked_songs_all}
positions_to_remove = [song['position'] for song in queue if song['song_id'] in liked_song_ids]
print("Positions to remove:", positions_to_remove)

# Remove from highest position to lowest to avoid index shifting
for pos in sorted(positions_to_remove, reverse=True):
    result = apis.spotify.remove_song_from_queue(position=pos, access_token=access_token)
    print(f"Removed position {pos}: {result}")
